svg.title: Academic paper writing workflow
svg.desc: Three writing phases share an evidence boundary, user-controlled Claim Decision, anti-overdefensive prose checks, and editable OMML validation.
svg.text: 从研究材料到可投稿论文
ONE ARGUMENT · THREE PHASES · ONE EVIDENCE BOUNDARY
